title: About profile visibility settings
description: Your birth date is private by default. Control who can see it and how >x< uses this information for age verification and personalization.

toc.title: How does >x< use my birth date?

runs: >x< takes privacy very seriously and does not share your non-public personal information, including your contact information, without your consent, or in the limited ways outlined in our
Below you'll find information about your profile visibility settings, and how >x< uses your birth date when added to your profile.

Most of the profile information you provide us is always public, like your biography, location, website, and picture. For certain profile information fields we provide you with visibility settings to select who on >x< can see this information in your >x< profile. If you provide us with profile information and you don’t see a visibility setting, that information is public.

Below are the visibility settings that are available for your birth date. Your settings allow you to separately control who on >x< can see your birth year and who can see your birth day and month in your >x< profile. Please note that the date of birth entered must be of the person operating the account.

How does >x< use my birth date?

If you choose to add your birth date to your profile, it will be displayed to the audience that you’ve chosen. Your birth date lets >x< know that you’re old enough to use our services. It will also be used to customize your >x< experience. For example, we will use your birth date to show you more relevant content, including ads. Learn more about how
